import json, os, pathlib, subprocess, time
root = pathlib.Path('/Users/berni/.codex/worktrees/e181/labs')
out = pathlib.Path('/tmp/cfc-source-dedup-e181')
target = root / 'packages/runner/src/cfc/prepare.ts'
versions = {arm: (out / f'prepare-{arm}.ts').read_bytes() for arm in ('baseline', 'fixed')}
records = []
try:
    for rep in range(1, 6):
        for arm in (('baseline', 'fixed') if rep % 2 else ('fixed', 'baseline')):
            target.write_bytes(versions[arm])
            name = f'{arm}-{rep}'
            record = {'rep': rep, 'arm': arm, 'start': time.time(), 'load_before': os.getloadavg()}
            with (out / f'{name}.json').open('w') as stdout, (out / f'{name}.log').open('w') as stderr:
                result = subprocess.run(['deno', 'run', '--no-lock', '--config', str(root / 'deno.jsonc'), '-A', str(out / 'replay.ts')], cwd=root, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr)
            record.update(exit_code=result.returncode, seconds=time.time() - record['start'], load_after=os.getloadavg())
            records.append(record)
            (out / 'interleave.json').write_text(json.dumps(records, indent=2) + '\n')
            if result.returncode:
                raise RuntimeError(f'{name} failed: see {name}.log')
            print(json.dumps(record), flush=True)
finally:
    target.write_bytes(versions['fixed'])
